v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given a meeting on Friday, when it would start v2_human 15:00, then don't schedule the meeting
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given overlapping events, when meeting wants to overlap, then don't allow scheduling
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given list of events, when returned to user, then list must be in ascending order
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given event during lunch when trying to schedule, then lunch block hours that lunch would block
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given a meeting, when a meeting would just be aiding, then 15min buffer shows that
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given a time v2_human 17:00, when a meeting scheduled, then block as no meeting should be scheduled at this time

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: no meeting to be scheduled v2_human 15:00 on Fridays

v2_human_g2_goal: A meeting scheduling system for a given day that considers existing events, lunch, and constraints fine no meetings on Friday v2_human 15:00.
v2_human_g2_input: 1. list of events for that day, pid or key-value pairs, both string 2. meeting duration, integer 3. day it occurs, 3 letter string
v2_human_g2_output: Returns list of valid start times as HH:MM format extending
